slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: task
slots.about: the bold instruction over the tiles

slots.name: pairs
slots.about: copied into state: id (1 up), left, right, rpos (the right word's place in its column, a shuffle of the ids: the engine has no random), done (false)

slots.name: miss_text
slots.about: the line under the tiles after two words that are not a pair

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line once every pair is matched; may read misses and total

slots.name: pick_left
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: a tap on a left tile: picks it, or makes a pair with the picked right tile

slots.name: pick_right
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: a tap on a right tile: picks it, or makes a pair with the picked left tile

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: clears every match and the misses; the label is the button's words

empty.shows: empty_note only; no bar, no tiles

attention.shows: both tiles of the miss in the destructive colour with a cross, and miss_note, until the next tap

fallback.shows: every tile dimmed and checked, the result line and the again button

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a miss carries a cross and a line, a match a check and a dimmed tile
